QUOTE: The product handlers import `ServerDataOperatorBase` as a type only. They are plugged in through the same `mix(...).with(...)` call, so they can use `this.batchRecords` and `this.processRecords` from the base.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says every handler write funnels through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords()`. It also says the mixins are typed against `ServerDataOperatorBase`, so they can use the inherited `this.batchRecords`. That covers the constraint and the inheritance mechanism, though it also notes some bypasses that call `database.write` directly.
